metadata.title: Rego Policy Libraries — nsa_cisa_kubernetes (NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guidance v1.2 (August 2022))

controls.title: Containers are not built/forced to run as non-root users

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Containers are not built/forced to run as non-root users

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Containers do not run with immutable (read-only) root filesystems where possible

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Container images are not scanned for vulnerabilities or misconfigurations throughout the build workflow

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Privileged containers are not prevented by a technical control

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Breakout-prone features (hostPID, hostIPC, hostNetwork) are not denied

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: hostPath volume mounts are not denied

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Containers executing as root or allowing elevation to root are not rejected

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Kernel-level hardening (SELinux, AppArmor, seccomp) is not applied to workloads

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Pod Security Admission (baseline or stricter) is not enforced cluster-wide

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Deployments are not restricted to trusted image registries

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Only digitally signed images are not enforced via admission control

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: automountServiceAccountToken is not set to false for Pods that do not need API access

controls.title: Access to control plane nodes is not locked down with a firewall and RBAC

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access to control plane nodes is not locked down with a firewall and RBAC

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Control plane components and worker nodes do not use separate networks

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Access to the etcd server is not further limited (dedicated node, firewall restricted to API servers)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Control plane components do not use authenticated, TLS-encrypted communications

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: etcd is not encrypted at rest

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: etcd does not use a separate TLS certificate (and trusts more than the API server certificates)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Namespaces are not used to partition resources (or user Pods run in kube-system/kube-public)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Network policies isolating resources are not defined (CNI must support the NetworkPolicy API)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No explicit default-deny (ingress and egress) network policy exists

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: LimitRange / ResourceQuota / PID limits are not enforced to prevent resource exhaustion

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Credentials are kept in configuration files, or Kubernetes Secrets are not encrypted with a strong method (they are not encrypted by default)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The API server (port 6443) is exposed to the internet or untrusted networks

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Cluster traffic is not encrypted with TLS 1.2 or 1.3 throughout

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Pods can reach the cloud instance metadata service (privilege-escalation vector)

controls.title: API server anonymous authentication is not disabled (--anonymous-auth=false)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: API server anonymous authentication is not disabled (--anonymous-auth=false)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Strong user authentication is not implemented (or weak methods like static password files are in use)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: RBAC is not enabled (--authorization-mode=RBAC), or AlwaysAllow is in effect

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: RBAC policies with unique least-privilege roles per users, administrators, developers, service accounts, and infrastructure team are not in place

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Anonymous access to the kubelet service is not disabled

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Kubelet client TLS authentication is not enforced

controls.title: Kubernetes audit logging is not enabled (it is disabled by default)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Kubernetes audit logging is not enabled (it is disabled by default)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No audit policy is configured (security-critical events at RequestResponse; requests involving Secrets reduced to Metadata level)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Logs are not persisted to survive node, Pod, or container failure

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Logs are not aggregated external to the cluster (TLS 1.2/1.3 in transit, append-only forwarder access)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No log monitoring and alerting system (SIEM or equivalent) is tailored to the cluster

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Pod behavioral baselines (network, requests, resource consumption) are not established at creation for anomaly detection

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: RBAC policy configuration is not periodically reviewed (and on personnel changes)

controls.title: Security patches and updates are not promptly applied (Kubernetes, hosts, hypervisors, plugins, CI/CD elements)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security patches and updates are not promptly applied (Kubernetes, hosts, hypervisors, plugins, CI/CD elements)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Periodic vulnerability scans and penetration tests are not performed

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Unused components are not uninstalled and deleted from the environment

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: CIS benchmarks for Kubernetes and system components are not adhered to / periodically verified
